name: Feature card
pick: (() => { const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,p')].find(el => el.textContent.trim() === 'Collaborate with your team'); for (let el = label?.parentElement; el && el !== document.body; el = el.parentElement) { const s = getComputedStyle(el); if (parseFloat(s.borderTopWidth) > 0 && s.borderTopStyle !== 'none') return el; } return null; })()
